name: Gardens by the Bay
desc: Supertrees glow for free every night; the cloud-forest dome charges. Sci-fi botany either way.

name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
desc: A surfboard balanced on three towers. Pool is guests-only, but the deck view still bankrupts your camera roll.

name: Merlion Park
desc: Half lion, half fish, forever spitting into the bay. Free photo with the city's weirdest mascot.

name: Singapore Botanic Gardens
desc: A UNESCO garden older than the country, free at dawn tai-chi hour. The orchid wing costs about a coffee.

name: Singapore Zoo
desc: Orangutans take breakfast beside you, barely a cage in sight. Save up — it's the good kind of splurge.

name: Night Safari
desc: The world's first nocturnal zoo. Tram through the dark while leopards silently judge your life.

name: Maxwell Food Centre
desc: Michelin-listed chicken rice for pocket change. The hawker dream: queue, feast, repeat.

name: Haw Par Villa
desc: A free, gloriously unhinged statue park of Chinese legends, Ten Courts of Hell included. Sleep well.

name: Jewel Changi Rain Vortex
desc: A 40-metre indoor waterfall inside an airport. Go for the mist, stay because your flight's delayed anyway.

name: East Coast Park
desc: 15km of beach, BBQ pits and rental bikes. Sunset satay by the sea costs less than a movie ticket.
